item.name: Upload a single document to a specific folder path

request.name: Upload a single document to a specific folder path

description.content: The body of the request should contain the file you wish to upload, as a base64 encoded string.
matterId of the matter you wish to upload the document into.

An attachment is not part of a matter's version history, but is typically used to store supporting documentation. A new 'version' is a new document saved as a new version, while a 'draft' version is an updated copy of the previous 'version' type group version. (This can only be one of attachment,draft,version)

query.description: (Required) Name of document

Whether, if a document of the same name already exists in the current folder, to 'replace' that document (existing document will be set to version_state:replaced, and version_group will change to the document_id of the document being uploaded), or if 'false' will return a 422 error code and the request will not complete.
